description: Class B owner-governed residual premise registry. These are explicit owner-adopted governance premises that retire formerly Tier-A derivation targets without reclassifying them as axioms or approved framework primitives. They chain-satisfy dependencies without Tier-A bounding after adoption, but they carry only the exact boundaries recorded here and in the adoption source. This registry is distinct from axiom_premise_nodes.json and tier_a_admissions.json.

staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.label: AC_phi_lambda
staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.boundary: Retires only the current minimum AC_phi_lambda Tier-A atoms: AC(i) matter-action occupancy grain and AC(ii) R-eta h-class/h-unit readout license. It supplies no value of r, delta, charged-lepton mass, mixing angle, probability rule, above-C3 taste/Dirac/chirality content, CKM/PMNS alignment, or sector-weight law.

strong_cp_theta_zero_note.label: theta
strong_cp_theta_zero_note.boundary: Retires only the current minimum theta Tier-A atoms: the gauge-side sector/readout plus phase-source premise and the mass-side W2 determinant-channel readout premise. It does not derive theta_bar = 0 by itself, a continuum theta theorem, quark masses, CKM structure, QCD continuum dynamics, a CP-odd coefficient theorem, an axion, or a fitted selector.
